Survey files step of the Load Data wizard

Source: R/wizard-survey_upload.R
survey_upload_ui.Rd

An optional step where the user can upload the country's survey data in place of the built-in survey data. It has one upload zone per file, each a Stata file (.dta): national, regional, area, maternal education and wealth index quintile. The files can be uploaded one at a time, and a file is recognised by the zone it is dropped into, not by its name. Each file is read for the dataset's country and saved with cache()$set_national_survey(), cache()$set_regional_survey(), cache()$set_area_survey(), cache()$set_education_survey() or cache()$set_wiq_survey(). A zone's reset button goes back to the built-in data (cache()$clear_national_survey() and so on). The step counts as complete when all five files are uploaded (see step_survey_files_complete()); being optional, it can be skipped.

Usage

survey_upload_ui(id, i18n)

survey_upload_server(id, cache, i18n)

Arguments

id

The module's id.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

cache

A reactive that returns the dataset, a CacheConnection.

Value

survey_upload_ui() returns the UI as Shiny tags: a card with the five upload zones. survey_upload_server() is called for its side effects and returns nothing useful.

Details

The national and regional files are read with load_survey_data(), the other three with load_equity_data(). A file that cannot be read shows an error banner under its zone. When the user has uploaded a regional survey whose region names do not all match the dataset's admin level 1 names (cache()$check_survey_admin_names()), a warning under the zones gives the number of names that do not match; the Map Survey Files step resolves them.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# in the server of the Load Data screen, where `cache` is a reactive holding the dataset:
# the step's page, for wizard_steps_server(), and its server
panel <- list(key = "survey_files", ui = survey_upload_ui(ns("survey_upload"), i18n))
survey_upload_server("survey_upload", cache, i18n)
} # }
